checks.finding: T-001/T-002 (Risk: medium, tasks.md:184,396) are new unprotected test files exercising live guards read-only via PATH/env-var indirection -- no auth/payment/PII/migration surface touched, medium is proportionate. T-003 (Risk: high, tasks.md:601) edits the sole R-10-protected file via human-copy, a CI-gate/required-checks surface where 'silent defect causes material harm' (policy high-tier clause) -- correctly high. T-004 (Risk: high, tasks.md:858) validates an inbound-prompt-injection security property (security-spec.md Boundary B2), a genuine security-sensitive test target -- correctly classified at the highest applicable tier per the policy's 'spans tiers, classify at highest' rule. No task shows a mismatch between declared tier and scope.

Both high-risk tasks carry the required Done-When evidence items. T-003 (tasks.md:802-812): explicit RED (dropped-step fixture fails self-check) / GREEN (staged candidate passes) pair, plus 'An independent quality-gate verdict, plus an independent review verdict distinct from the implementing agent, records PASS for this task (high-risk requirement)'. T-004 (tasks.md:1088-1097): explicit RED (mutated-stub fixture fails non-execution assertion) / GREEN (real entry-point result recorded regardless of outcome) pair, plus the same independent-review-verdict language. Neither task is Risk: critical, so second-approver/signed-bundle evidence is not required.

T-002/T-003/T-004 each carry 6 Done-When items. T-001 carries 9 (tasks.md:338-369), nominally over the 8-item indicator, but all 9 map 1:1 onto REQ-001's already-approved AC-001..AC-007 enumeration (WFI-014 branch-enumeration discipline) plus 2 shared cross-cutting boilerplate items common to every task in this feature -- all confined to ONE file and ONE script's fallback chain, not scope creep. Scope sections across all 4 tasks stay within a single primary suite/artifact plus the same shared registration/CHANGELOG/doc-surface legs; no task title implies multiple sequential phases. No fragmentation observed.

T-001: AC-005 (deny_unavailable fail-closed, both emit modes) is an explicit error-path case (acceptance-tests.md:25). T-002: AC-008/009/010 are themselves a negative/adversarial corpus, and AC-010 adds a false-positive control case (acceptance-tests.md:28-30). T-003: AC-017 is a RED-then-GREEN dropped-step detection self-check (acceptance-tests.md:37) and AC-018 an explicit non-regression case (acceptance-tests.md:38). T-004: AC-014 is a RED/GREEN non-vacuity proof for the injection defense (acceptance-tests.md:34), and AC-013's closed-list cross-check catches invented tool_name literals. Every functional task pairs happy-path ACs with at least one genuine error/edge-path AC.

T-001 (tasks.md:210-224) and T-002 (tasks.md:427-436) explicitly override acceptance-tests.md's coarser 'unit' column label with a task-level 'integration' classification, correctly justified: TEST-001..011 each drive 2+ real independent components -- matching this check's own integration definition. T-003/T-004 carry no task-level override, but acceptance-tests.md's per-TEST-ID Test Type column accurately describes each test's actual scope. No mismatch found between any stated type and its target's real scope.

T-003 (Risk: high, tasks.md:683-692) carries a detailed Rollback field covering both the un-applied-commit-revert case and the already-human-applied case, requiring a second human-copy application with an explicit revert-boundary record. T-004 (Risk: high, tasks.md:959-961) carries a Rollback field stating a reviewed commit revert suffices since it stages no protected-file candidate of its own. Both high-risk tasks satisfy the rollback-consideration requirement.

The only genuinely protected/shared file is staged solely by T-003 (Protected Files, tasks.md:56-94 -- T-001/T-002/T-004 never touch it, staged or live), so no uncoordinated write collision exists there. tests/run-all.sh and CHANGELOG.md are each edited by all 4 tasks, but Global Constraints (tasks.md:120-133,140-145) pre-assigns each task a distinct, non-overlapping line/entry (run-all.sh lines 37/47/48/49; four independently-keyed CHANGELOG entries citing different issue numbers) with an explicit non-conflict rationale. No two tasks claim the same primary implementation file for the same purpose without this documented non-overlap.

The new T-003->T-004 edge itself is truthful and non-spurious: staged-workflow-candidate.draft.yml:387-389 genuinely names T-004's suite path, the quotation at tasks.md:843-844 now matches requirements.md's Main Workflows item 4 verbatim, and no cycle exists (T-004's own Blockers, tasks.md:1124-1126, remain 'None'). However, a second, uncorrected defect of the same class remains elsewhere: T-003's Done-When bullet for TEST-020 (tasks.md:794-797) states 'TEST-020 confirms the staged candidate contains a CI step for each new suite from T-001 and T-002 (AC-020)' -- omitting T-004 -- and traceability.md's Acceptance Mapping row for AC-020 (traceability.md:56) states 'T-003 (stages T-001's and T-002's CI steps; T-004's own leg explicitly deferred, requirements.md Non-goals)'. Both contradict: (1) acceptance-tests.md's hash-frozen AC-020 row, which explicitly reconciles Stream C's own workflow-scenarios suite into this AC's scope now that Stream C is unblocked and landed; (2) design.md:409,584 ('AC-019/AC-020 name Streams A, B, and C's three product suites as the required minimum'); (3) requirements.md:335, whose Non-goals section states Stream C's CI step is no longer deferred once ADR-0010 was Accepted -- the opposite of what traceability.md cites it for; and (4) the verified staged-workflow-candidate.draft.yml:387-389, which does contain T-004's step. T-003's own Scope section (tasks.md:750-756) correctly lists all 4 suites, so this is an internal inconsistency confined to the Done-When acceptance bullet and the traceability mapping row -- a downstream quality-gate reviewer following T-003's stated Done-When text for TEST-020/AC-020 could certify AC-020 without re-confirming Stream C's CI step is present, and traceability.md's row misattributes requirements.md Non-goals as authority for excluding it when that section says the opposite.

SKIP: no bugfix or debugging task in scope. All 4 tasks are new-test-suite/CI-lane-addition tasks (Stream A-D), not bugfix, regression-fix, debugging, flaky-test-resolution, or incident-remediation tasks by title, Goal, Scope, or Done When text.

findings.finding: tasks.md:794-797's Done-When bullet for TEST-020/AC-020 and traceability.md:56's Acceptance Mapping row both state AC-020 covers only T-001's and T-002's CI steps with 'T-004's own leg explicitly deferred' -- contradicting acceptance-tests.md's AC-020 row, design.md:409/584, requirements.md:335 (Non-goals: Stream C's step is no longer deferred), and the verified content of staged-workflow-candidate.draft.yml:387-389 which does contain T-004's step. T-003's own Scope section correctly lists all 4 suites, so this is an internal documentation inconsistency in the task's own acceptance criterion and in traceability.md's mapping, risking an incomplete AC-020 verification by a downstream quality-gate reviewer who follows the stated Done-When text literally.
